actions.tooltip: OrElse: a left-biased choice. Reads from s1 are still tracked even when s2 runs, so the combined transaction blocks if both retry.

objects.tooltip: s1 : STM a — primary transaction.  If it commits, sr is its result.
s2 : STM a — alternative transaction tried only if s1 calls retry.
STM a — result of whichever branch commits.  Never blocks unless both branches retry.

flows.label: run s1; on retry, run s2
